Ewan read it twice, then a third time, while the lens above him turned its slow, patient circles, sweeping light across a sea that had just given something back.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未重启的机器。路灯把空街拉成昏黄的长廊，扫帚声一下一下，是唯一的节拍。写字楼里零星的灯，像不肯睡去的眼睛。便利店店员趴在柜台打盹，关东煮的热气模糊了玻璃。首班车碾过路口时，天边泛起蟹壳青。早点铺卷帘门哗啦作响，蒸笼升起白雾——城市在梦与醒之间，悄悄换了一口气。", "w03": "• Recursion is like Russian nesting dolls: to open the whole set, you open one doll and then do exactly the same thing to the doll inside.\n• Every time you repeat the step, the problem gets a little smaller, until you reach the tiniest doll, which is empty — that is the stopping point.\n• So a recursive task is one that calls a simpler copy of itself, over and over, until it becomes so simple it can finish on its own."}
